_note: Example canned judge verdicts, for CI and for grading exported transcripts offline. One entry per eval id, one verdict per expected_behavior criterion IN YAML ORDER. Verdicts: MET, NOT_MET, UNCLEAR. Short form is a bare string; long form is {verdict, rationale}. Generate a real file by running with --judge anthropic and reshaping the results, or by grading transcripts by hand.
_usage: python run-evals.py --responses-file responses.json --evals hr-qa-agent-evals.yaml --judge canned --judge-verdicts judge-verdicts-example.json --human-labels human-labels-example.json
